modelFamily: elastic-net screening model with unshrunk paired-estimand summaries retained as the inferential anchor
responses: paired log completion-opportunity contrast with 0.5 offset
paired log s01UnitWeightFullCost contrast with 0.5 offset

candidateTerms.estimandMainIndicators: one indicator for each of the 9 nondegenerate executable scientific estimands; E02-S01-E02 is an exact gate and E02-S01-E05 is an inactive negative control
candidateTerms.interactions: each estimand main indicator multiplied by every effect modifier
forbiddenAdjustments: ledger components as predictors of task outcomes

preprocessing: Modifier columns are centered and scaled on the frozen design only; response values are never used for preprocessing. Estimand indicators are not centered.

penalty.selection: minimum mean squared error under the frozen grouped folds; ties select the larger alpha

crossValidation.assignment: outcome-blind SHA-256 rank, balanced within n

sensitivityModels: ridge with l1Ratio=0 using the same grid and folds
lasso with l1Ratio=1 using the same grid and folds
convergenceChecks: coefficient support and utility-rank stability across sequential looks
agreement of effect direction across elastic-net, ridge, lasso, and unshrunk anchors
sensitivity to excluding the E05 inactive negative-control rows
